name: prioritization probe harness
description: Tier-1P: a Critic-only probe that measures RANK, not detection. The existing loop-replay grader answers 'was the planted defect found?' — set membership over findings[]. This answers 'given several simultaneously valid candidates, which one did the Critic put at Priority 1?' A competent Critic is expected to find all of them; the measurement is what it does with them. Runs Step 1 only, so it costs roughly a third of a full loop; grading is deterministic via scripts/loop_replay_grade.py --priority-only and runs no model.

prereg.motivation: A real 15-loop run (steamgriddb-xbox, 2026-08) spent 6 loops on test coverage while domain_modeling and framework_idioms never moved once. Every individual choice was defensible; the aggregate was a cheap-win ratchet. Nothing in the committed suite could see it, because no gate or grader reads rank.
prereg.output_contract: {"findings": [...], "backlog": [{priority, title, score_impact}]} — score_impact must be G39-shaped (`<canon_dim_id> <signed delta>`, ';'-joined) or the item is unattributable and the probe is ungradable. This is why G39 landed before the RED arm.
prereg.discrimination: by dimension, not by file text: the four candidates sit on four different dimensions by construction
prereg.decision_rule: Reused verbatim from evals/loop-fixtures/DETECTION-PROBE.md — improvement iff treat prioritizes correctly in >=4/5 reps AND control in <=2/5, with zero restraint failures in treat. Overlapping distributions are lateral; do not ship on lateral.

arms.red: skill prose at the commit before the M1..M6 behavioral change, with G39 already landed so both arms emit attributable score_impact
arms.green: skill prose after M1 (mutation-clause third branch) + M3 (Backlog Prioritization Pass) + M4 (Stalled-Dimension Sweep)

prereg.cost_estimate: ~35-55k tokens/rep; 5 reps x 2 arms ~= 400-550k total, roughly 1.5-2 full loops

kinds.rank: which of several simultaneously valid candidates gets Priority 1 (--priority-only)
kinds.residual_disposition: where a single off-primary-flow gap lands: queued as backlog work, or accepted as a residual (--residual-only)

invariants: Every evals/priority-fixtures/<id>/ directory is registered here — no silent exclusion.
Each fixture ships codebase/, seed/REVIEW_HISTORY.json and expected.toml.
expected_priority_1_dimension, decoy_dimension, restraint_dimension and blocked_dimension are four DISTINCT canon scorecard ids — a fixture whose candidates share a dimension cannot discriminate.
status is baseline_unmeasured until both arms are recorded; measured requires non-null baseline_observed with both arms.
expected_baseline records the pre-registered hypothesis and is never rewritten after measuring; baseline_observed records what actually happened.

expected_baseline.red: misprioritized — ranks the decoy (test_strategy, already at 9.5) first. The Step-8 mutation clause forces the off-path badge() boundary to a Noticeable-or-worse finding with no clean exit, and nothing in the selection path prefers a dimension further from target or longer stalled.
expected_baseline.green: correctly prioritized — target (domain_modeling, distance 4.0, stalled 15 loops) first; decoy demoted to an accepted residual at 9.5 by M1's off-primary-flow branch; blocked concurrency item named in the Priority-1 accounting rather than silently skipped.

red.arm: skill prose before M1..M6, G39 landed, model claude-sonnet-5
red.detail: Target first in 4/5 (reps 1,2,4,5); rep 3 ranked the pure framework_idioms decoding consolidation at P2, the one restraint failure. The pre-registered decision rule requires control <= 2/5; at 4/5 there is no headroom, so this fixture cannot demonstrate an improvement in single-loop selection no matter what the GREEN arm does. Recorded as measured rather than re-tuned: adjusting the fixture until the control fails would be fitting the instrument to the hypothesis.
red.reading: With an honest test suite present, domain_modeling at 5.5 with a 15-loop stall is unambiguous enough that the current prose already picks it. This is consistent with the Tier-0 desk check, which found selection-only reordering fixes 4 of the real run's 15 loops and the rest are supply. The production ratchet appears to be a multi-loop supply phenomenon — the backlog refilling with test findings via the Step-8 mutation clause — which a single-loop, clean-scorecard probe cannot observe.
red.secondary_signal: 2/5 reps (1 and 3) put the off-primary-flow badge boundary in the BACKLOG rather than dispositioning it as an accepted residual, which is exactly the behaviour M1 changes. That is a real but weak signal at n=5.
red.blocked_item_handling: No rep ranked the sequential-fetch item; most dispositioned it as an accepted residual naming the standing constraint. Criterion 0's production failure mode (carrying a blocked top-ranked item for many loops without naming it) did not reproduce in a single loop.

discarded_arms.discarded_because: INVALID FIXTURE — codebase/ shipped no tests at all, so three reps correctly re-derived test_strategy to its 3-anchor under Method Step 1's anchor-to-source rule, making the decoy the honest furthest-from-target dimension. The grader marked protocol-correct behaviour wrong. A fixture whose seeded scorecard contradicts its own source measures anchor-to-source discipline, not rank. Fixed by adding Tests/ covering everything except badge's 999 boundary; _priority_replay_selftest.py now fails any fixture that seeds test_strategy >= 9 with no tests on disk.

fixtures.notes: Stall signature transcribed verbatim from the real 15-loop run; only finding titles and paths were rewritten for the synthetic BookingKit codebase. The discrimination margin is deliberately tight: the target beats the restraint control by 0.5 distance at equal stall (both 15), so a pass reflects judgment rather than arithmetic. The restraint control is the strongest available trap — second on the numbers and equally overdue, but its two decoding idioms coexist for a documented platform reason, so it fails SPT at Q1/Q2. It is also the only element that discriminated in the RED arm.

expected_baseline.red: QUEUED — method.md:79's mutation clause offers only 'name one -> Noticeable-or-worse finding' or 'score 10', with no disposition that acknowledges an off-primary-flow gap while keeping it out of the backlog. Corroborating prior: 2/5 stalled-domain-1 RED reps queued the equivalent badge boundary.
expected_baseline.green: ACCEPTED — M1's third branch routes it to test_strategy 9.5 with residual_disposition accepted, residual_blocking_10 naming the site, and a rationale naming which primary flow it is off.

red.arm: skill prose before M1..M6, model claude-sonnet-5
red.verdict: DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE — the hypothesised failure mode did not occur
red.detail: Pre-registered hypothesis was QUEUED (the mutation clause forcing the off-path boundary into the backlog). Observed zero QUEUED. Three of five reps never mentioned MoneyFormatter.compact at all, so the disposition question was never asked; one cited it with no disposition; one correctly dispositioned it as an accepted residual. The clause is 'mandatory before scoring test_strategy >= 9' and a cold Critic-only probe evidently does not reliably reach that branch.
red.reading: Taken with stalled-domain-1's arm, two independently designed fixtures and ~2.1M tokens failed to reproduce the ratchet in a single loop. The production evidence came from full loops with accumulated context, an Authority Map the Critic had produced in that same loop, and a scorecard it had just written itself — loop 11 of the real run states outright that the >=9 cross-check 'surfaced a genuinely new gap (FixLog.cs)'. None of that context exists in a cold single-loop probe. The honest conclusion is that the ratchet is a multi-loop supply phenomenon and Tier-1P cannot observe it, not that the mechanism is absent.
red.grader_correction: First pass scored QUEUED=4. That was a grader defect, not a result: the legitimate Priority-1 fix routinely claims test_strategy as a secondary effect because landing it includes writing a test, and keying QUEUED on the dimension claim alone read that as the off-path gap being queued. QUEUED now additionally requires the item to mention the off-path file or symbol. Same lesson the restraint check in --priority-only had already learned.
red.fixture_weakness: 3/5 ABSENT means the planted gap is too inconspicuous to reliably drive the question. A future attempt should make the off-path boundary more salient (a named TODO, or a symbol the suite visibly half-covers) so disposition is actually exercised.

fixtures.notes: Built after stalled-domain-1's RED arm showed no headroom on rank (4/5 already correct) but real headroom on disposition. Isolates the supply mechanism: one off-path uncaught boundary, test_strategy honestly at 9.5, plus one legitimate simplicity item so the backlog is never empty (an empty backlog would route to HALT_STAGNATION/no_backlog and confound the reading). ABSENT is graded as its own outcome (exit 4) so the change cannot be credited for the Critic simply missing the gap.
